title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of Intersecting Melodies — Episode4 Not Something I'd Say

meta.Event Outline: Ichika has her eye on the last copy of a CD by an artist who creates Miku songs, but so does a fellow shopper—a girl with long hair. Surprisingly, the girl allows Ichika to take it. Putting the pieces together, Mafuyu realizes the girl in question was Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Here's that CD you told me about, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You don't have to thank me. I'm just acting as a liaison.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'll be able to listen to this now because you went through all this trouble.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, Mafuyu brought me a CD just now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's by an artist who produces VIRTUAL SINGER songs. I'm borrowing it from a girl at Mafuyu's school.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier since I'd given up on being able to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Good for you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's just, hearing what you said just now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It made my chest feel warm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade, would it be alright if I could listen to that CD too?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
I'll bring a CD player next time so we can all listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
And thank you again, Mafuyu.
I promise to return this once I'm done... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
There's a sheet of paper in this bag.
Is this yours, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, it must belong to the owner of this CD. She may've put it in here by accident.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
These might be hers.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She mentioned that she's in a band and they're making their own music to become professional musicians...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She also said that they've been learning how to actually create their own music, and she personally seemed very interested in you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She even asked what kind of music you compose, so I shared a link to our videos with her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I might be interested in hearing how she feels after seeing what we've made...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know what this person's like, but she seems to be taking her music very seriously...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. She seems to have written and rewritten some parts quite a few times. A lot must've been going through her mind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have a feeling that she hasn't been able to grasp a clear image of this song yet.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's a little different from what you write, Mafuyu, but each word seems to give me a sense of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think this person writes good lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A little...
I can't write the way she does.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I didn't expect her to write anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So I'm a little interested now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Hoshino must be trying to send some kind of message.)
